findings.description: FND-1: tinker.md Mode 2 invoked check-prune-resurrection.js from ${WORKSPACE} (FUSE), but the script is classified clone-invoked-only and does not exist on FUSE. node failed MODULE_NOT_FOUND (RC=1); the two-branch guard treated any RC!=3 as 'clean' — so the PROP-099 prune-resurrection canary has silently reported clean without ever running on every per-spec Mode 2 invocation since PROP-099 landed 2026-06-14. (Runs that happened to invoke from the clone, like today's, did execute it.) Dead-canary class: worse than no canary because it manufactures green.

suggested_fix.replace: RESURRECT=$(node "${CLONE}/monitor/scripts/check-prune-resurrection.js" --hours 48 2>/dev/null) [+ 3-branch RC guard: 0=clean / 3=live / else=SCRIPT ERROR do-not-report-clean]
suggested_fix.rationale: Clone always has the script and fresh git-side state (the canary reads git-owned archive JSONL tombstones — clone is the more correct substrate anyway). Strict RC discrimination prevents the silent-false-clean class recurring for ANY future canary failure mode.
